message: You know how storms can sneak up on you? One minute you’re sipping your coffee and the next, the sky turns a delightful shade of gray. I’ve learned that being prepared makes all the difference. The National Weather Service has some handy tips on staying safe during floods and storms. It's pretty reassuring to finally feel like the prepared one for once, instead of the one scrambling for the flashlight. What’s your favorite tip for weathering a storm? 🌧️
